overview: A minimalist, high-conversion single-page landing site for Cult & Clay — a philosophically deep Indian slow-fashion brand. Quiet luxury storytelling, Khadi cotton and natural ittars, contemporary global silhouettes for modern women.
features: Full-screen hero with sticky nav and animated Khadi texture background
Product launch carousel with INR/USD price toggle
Story and manifesto section with parallax gallery
SEO optimized with Open Graph tags
Scroll-triggered reveal animations and clay ripple buttons
